market_question: Will Arsenal finish in 2nd place in the 2025-26 English Premier League?
reasoning: Arsenal have finished 2nd in each of the last two Premier League seasons and are expected to be title contenders again in 2025-26, with a high probability of a top-2 finish. The market-implied 16.5% for an exact 2nd place is too low given their consistency and squad strength relative to rivals like Manchester City, who are likely to be champions. I estimate a ~25% chance of Arsenal finishing exactly 2nd, providing a clear edge on ‘Yes’.
evidence_points: Arsenal finished 2nd in 2022-23 and 2023-24, establishing themselves as a top-2 side
Mikel Arteta’s young squad continues to develop, with most key players under long-term contracts
Manchester City remain favorites for the title, making Arsenal a strong candidate for the runner-up spot
sources_consulted: General knowledge of Arsenal’s squad and performance trends
Polymarket current odds and comparison with general title odds
